data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 王家寝宫的纱幔凝视
data.description: 阿尔迪基亚王宫深处的华丽寝殿内，重重叠叠的金色丝绸纱幔在晚风中低语。拉·芙利亚侧倚在雕花大床深处，一袭轻柔如烟的浅金白纱裙半露香肩。银发铺满了刺绣枕席，她单手轻点红唇，祖母绿眼眸中敛去了所有王家的伪装与计谋，只余下纯粹而坚定的心仪之情。
data.location: ancient royal castle bedchamber with gossamer silk canopy
data.action: reclining amidst gold embroidered silk cushions under royal canopy, sheer white silk gown, long silver hair splayed, green eyes radiant with intimate devotion
data.lighting: golden candelabra glow illuminating translucent royal canopy drapes
data.mood: sumptuous palace romance, total sovereign surrender of the heart
data.promptProse: Reclining amidst luxurious silk bedding beneath a golden canopy in her royal chamber, La Folia rests in a delicate sheer nightgown. Her silver hair flows across embroidered pillows as she smiles with serene royal devotion.
data.animaCaption: La Folia reclining on an ornate canopy bed in a royal palace chamber, smiling with quiet devotion.
